# Prepare Environment

```{r}
#| label: load packages
#| message: false # removes tidyverse loader & here location for privacy
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(tidymodels)

source(here("functions", "set_env-variables.R"))
source(file.path(PATH_FUNCTIONS, "load_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load best model config

selected_config <- load_selected_config(threshold = TRUE)
```

# Train Set Resamples

## Load Resources

```{r}
#| label: load model based on resamples

resample_fit <- load_model("resample")
```

## Obtain Predictions

```{r}
#| label: get train predictions

resample_preds <- resample_fit %>%
  augment() %>%
  mutate(.row = row_number()) %>%
  # get fold ids back
  inner_join(
    resample_fit %>%
      collect_predictions() %>%
      select(.row, fold_id = id),
    by = join_by(.row)
  ) %>%
  select(-.row) %>%
  mutate(.pred_class = factor(
    if_else(.pred_TRUE >= selected_config[["threshold"]], TRUE, FALSE),
    levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)
  ))
```



# Test Set

## Load resources

```{r}
#| label: load best imputation technique and final fitted model

selected_imp <- load_recipe(selected_config[["imp"]])
final_fit <- load_model("full")
```

```{r}
#| label: load test df

test_df <- load_split_df("test")
```

## Preprocess test data

When splitting the dataset, i used the version that still includes NA's for depression, as those were still used to train the imputation techniques. Thus i need to reduce the test df first before using it to evaluate.

```{r}
#| label: reduce test df

test_df <- test_df %>%
  filter_relevant()
```

```{r}
#| label: impute test df

test_imp <- bake(selected_imp, test_df)
```

## Obtain Predictions

```{r}
#| label: get test predictions

test_preds <- final_fit %>%
  augment(test_imp) %>%
  mutate(.pred_class = factor(if_else(.pred_TRUE >= selected_config[["threshold"]], TRUE, FALSE), levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)))
```

# Export

```{r}
#| label: export predictions

save_predicted_df(resample_preds, type = "resample")
save_predicted_df(test_preds, type = "test")
```
